correctness.rationale: Exact differentiation gives dJ/dt=z^2-b y^2 and the symbolic artifact returns zero residual. Generator identities yield the invariant-measure constraints. LaSalle invariance on any bounded forward orbit proves convergence to one equilibrium for b<=0. For a nonconstant periodic orbit, the balance plus sharp Wirtinger gives P>=2*pi/sqrt(b); equality would force a pure first harmonic, but substitution produces a nonzero second harmonic -R^2/2, so the inequality is strict.

No inspected statement gives the compact invariant-measure RMS balance, the bounded-orbit recurrence barrier for b<=0, or the strict universal period floor. Classical third-order stability work may contain an equivalent auxiliary identity, so the originality claim is centered on these Genesio-specific global consequences.
